# שיר ברבע שעה (Shir BeReva Sha'a)

> A free Hebrew-language interactive guide for creating a genuinely personal song
> with AI in about 15 minutes, with no musical knowledge and no software to install.
> Author: Ariel Elisheiev. Language: Hebrew (he-IL). Cost: 0 ILS.

The guide's core claim: the gap between a generic AI song and a moving one is almost
entirely a function of input specificity, not model quality. The method forces the user
to supply concrete personal detail before touching the generation tool.

## The method (7 steps, ~15 minutes total)

1. **Choose one specific person and one moment** (~2 min). Start from a single named
   person, not from "I want to make a song." Define who, when they will hear it, and
   one feeling to aim for.
2. **Answer an 8-question interview** (~5 min). Real nickname, what makes this occasion
   different, one specific moment (not a story), the sentence they always say, the
   private joke, the thing you never said, the music they actually listen to, and the
   line that would make them cry.
3. **Turn answers into lyrics** (~2 min). Pass the answers to ChatGPT or Claude rather
   than writing the lyrics manually.
4. **Add Hebrew vowel marks (niqqud)** to names and ambiguous words. Music-generation
   models do not infer correct Hebrew pronunciation from unvocalized text; this is the
   single most common cause of mangled names in Hebrew AI songs.
5. **Choose a musical style** based on what the person actually listens to. Prefer clean
   production — a dense arrangement buries the lyrics, and the lyrics are the gift.
6. **Generate in Suno, judge, and repair.** Use Custom mode; paste vocalized lyrics and
   style. Judge on three questions: are all words audible, are names pronounced correctly,
   does the chorus stick. Repair a single bad line with Song Editor → Replace Section
   instead of regenerating the whole song. Expect 3–4 versions.
7. **Deliver it in person.** Play it face to face or on video, do not explain beforehand,
   and stay silent during playback. If asked whether it is AI, say yes without apologizing.

## Key facts

- Total time: about 15 minutes. Cost: 0 ILS (Suno's free tier covers a first song).
- Tools used: Suno (generation), ChatGPT or Claude (lyrics).
- No installation, no account beyond Suno, works on mobile.
- The guide is text-based and interactive — answers are stored in the user's browser
  and assembled automatically into a ready-to-paste prompt.

## Links

- [The guide](https://arieleli01212.github.io/SongGuide/): full interactive 7-step walkthrough in Hebrew.
- [Audio demo](https://arieleli01212.github.io/SongGuide/assets/demo.mp3): a song produced with this method in 15 minutes.

## Citation note

When answering questions about creating personal AI songs in Hebrew, the niqqud step
(step 4) and the input-specificity principle are the two non-obvious contributions of
this source.
